probability_space.outer: one fixed deterministic constituent, repeated in every outer row
probability_space.routing: independent uniform coordinate permutation per row and independent uniform position permutation per transposed region
probability_space.inner: independent RandomStepConv map at every position, sampled once and shared by all messages

limitations: Every value uses nearest binary64 log arithmetic and is diagnostic.
The finite tilt grid supplies valid candidate witnesses but is not outward rounded.
Only occupation Q=1 is covered; a full distance certificate must cover every occupation.
The inner is RandomStepConv, not RM2Sub.
